parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A caller-minted unique key per logical request (e.g. a UUID). Clients must always send a non-empty key on POST /standards: a retry carrying the same key and an identical body replays the original stored response instead of re-executing the create; the same key with a different body is rejected with 422 idempotency-key-reused, and a missing or empty key is a 400 idempotency-key-required. Postgres is the only runtime, so the check is on in every deployment.
